description:
Research archive for the manuscript Spatial explanations of OD demand effects: Topological structure and error-controlled boundary profiles. Scripts reproduce every table and figure; README files map each reported result to its generating script, fixed random seeds, and numerical gates. Includes: scripts/ (all experiment and figure scripts e1–e153), results/ (frozen result arrays; large regenerable artifacts such as solver shards and model checkpoints are documented in the READMEs and regenerated from the frozen seeds), paper_v112/ (complete LaTeX source chain and compiled PDF), and figures/.

Code under MIT; data and result arrays under CC-BY-4.0.
